author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Justin Crawford (knee) completes pregame workout Sunday
desc: Justin Crawford went through a pregame workout on Sunday.
impact: Crawford was scratched from Friday's lineup against the Detroit Tigers due to left knee soreness and has not played since. He did complete a pregame workout on Sunday, indicating he could be ready for game action following the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Daniel Susac (back) could return following All-Star break
desc: Daniel Susac is currently on a rehab assignment with Triple-A Sacramento and is on track to return during the San Francisco Giants' series against the Seattle Mariners from July 17-19.
impact: Susac has been sidelined since June 26 due to a lower back strain. When he returns, Eric Haase or Jesus Rodriguez are candidates to be optioned to make room on the roster.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) throws 52 pitches in rehab start Sunday
desc: Jordan Montgomery threw 52 pitches over four innings in a rehab start on Sunday for Triple-A Round Rock.
impact: Montgomery allowed one run on four hits with one strikeout. He is continuing to work his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Dax Fulton recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Miami Marlins recalled Dax Fulton from Triple-A Jacksonville on Sunday.
impact: With William Kempner (elbow) being placed on the injured list, Fulton will take his place in the bullpen. Fulton has made three appearances in the majors, posting a 2.57 ERA and 0.86 WHIP with six strikeouts across seven innings. He provides the Marlins with a multi-inning relief option.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cody Bradford (elbow) throws 21 pitches in rehab start Sunday
desc: Cody Bradford threw 21 pitches over one inning in his rehab start on Sunday.
impact: Bradford was scheduled to pitch just one inning. He'll continue to build-up his pitch count.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: William Kempner (elbow) lands on IL
desc: The Miami Marlins placed William Kempner on the 15-day injured list on Sunday due to a right elbow sprain.
impact: Kempner has been dealing with an elbow issue for several weeks, which eventually landed him on the injured list. He underwent further testing on Sunday to determine the severity of the injury. In a corresponding move, Dax Fulton was recalled from Triple-A Jacksonville.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Abimelec Ortiz optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Nationals optioned Abimelec Ortiz to Triple-A Rochester.
impact: Ortiz returns to Triple-A heading into the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Antwone Kelly optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Pirates optioned RHP Antwone Kelly to Triple-A Indianapolis.
impact: Kelly threw two innings on Sunday. He should continue to be up and down throughout the summer.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Petersen dealing with hamstring injury
desc: Michael Petersen is dealing with right hamstring tightness and will undergo further testing to determine the severity.
impact: Petersen sustained the injury during Saturday's outing against the Cleveland Guardians, as he was seen shaking his right leg before exiting the game. He will undergo further examination to determine the severity of the issue and whether he will require a stint on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Davis optioned to Triple-A
desc: The White Sox optioned RHP Tyler Davis to Triple-A Charlotte.
impact: Davis will return to Triple-A with Trevor Richards activated from the bereavement list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Trevor Richards activated from bereavement list
desc: The White Sox activated RHP Trevor Richards from the bereavement list.
impact: Richards was away for a few days. He'll be back after the All-Star break.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tyler Glasnow (back) begins bullpen progression
desc: Tyler Glasnow has begun a bullpen progression.
impact: Glasnow has been sidelined since May 8 due to lower back spasms and has only recently begun throwing fastball-only bullpen sessions. He has progressed slowly through his rehab, as there have been instances where he has played catch but did not feel well afterward. Fantasy managers should expect the Dodgers to continue taking a cautious approach with his recovery. He remains without a clear timetable for his return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Adam Frazier (elbow) nearing rehab assignment
desc: Adam Frazier has been participating in baseball activities and is nearing a minor league rehab assignment.
impact: Frazier has been sidelined since June 8 due to right elbow inflammation. He has been hitting on the field, taking grounders and running without any issues. He is close to beginning a minor league rehab assignment and could return to the active roster by the end of July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Edward Cabrera (hamstring/adductor) to throw during break
desc: Edward Cabrera will throw during the All-Star break, with a bullpen session expected to follow one week later.
impact: Cabrera suffered strains in his left hamstring and left adductor while stretching to receive a throw at first base on June 23 against the New York Mets. He has resumed throwing, along with light running and agility work. He will continue his rehab program throughout the All-Star break and could return to the mound sometime in August.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ben Brown (neck) to begin throwing program after break
desc: Ben Brown has begun plyo ball work and will begin a throwing program after the All-Star break.
impact: Brown has been sidelined since June 21 due to a stress reaction in a bone within his neck. He has increased his activity as tolerated and will begin a throwing program after the All-Star break. He does not have a timetable for his return.
